verdict.rationale: Gemini's own Scheduled Actions let users set recurring actions that run automatically on a daily, weekly, or monthly schedule, such as a daily news digest. That is time-triggered automation, but nothing shows user-defined rules that fire on arbitrary events like a new email or a calendar change. Missing for 10: event-based (non-time) triggers, conditional rule definition, triggered actions across connected apps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
